summary:
THE LAST SIGNAL is a project we developed to bring attention to the NASA equipment that was left behind on the Moon and Mars. When we think about space exploration, we usually think about rockets, astronauts and big discoveries, but we rarely think about the equipment that was left behind after these missions. We wanted to change that.

Through our website, people can explore different pieces of NASA equipment, understand what they were used for, why they were left behind and what they helped scientists discover. We have tried to make everything simple, visual and easy to understand, even for someone who knows absolutely nothing about space.

Our main aim was to make people interested in something they might normally ignore. We wanted to show that these objects are not just old equipment sitting on the Moon or Mars, they actually have stories behind them and helped us learn more about space.

With THE LAST SIGNAL, we hope people realise that even though these objects were left behind, their importance and the discoveries they helped make should not be forgotten.
details:
THE LAST SIGNAL is an educational website that allows people to explore the NASA equipment that was left behind on the Moon and Mars. The main idea is to help people understand the stories behind these objects, instead of just seeing them as old equipment sitting on the Moon or Mars.

The website allows visitors to explore different pieces of equipment and learn what they were used for, why they were left behind and what they helped scientists discover. We have focused on explaining everything in simple language and using visuals so that even someone with zero knowledge about space can understand what is happening. We want visitors to learn something new without feeling like they are reading a complicated science textbook.

One of the main benefits of our project is that it makes space exploration more interesting and easier to understand. It also brings attention to something that people usually don't think about when discussing space missions. We often talk about the astronauts and the discoveries, but not as much about the equipment that made some of those discoveries possible.

Our intended impact is to make more people curious about space exploration and help them understand the importance of these objects. Even though some of this equipment was left behind, its contribution to science should not be forgotten.

We developed the website using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, with Google AI Studio and AI assistance during development. These technologies helped us build the website, organise its content and create an interactive experience. We did not require any special hardware to develop the project.

What makes THE LAST SIGNAL different is its focus on telling the stories of equipment that people might normally overlook. Instead of only presenting facts, we wanted to make visitors understand why each object matters.

While developing the project, we considered scientific accuracy, simplicity, visual design, accessibility and the experience of someone visiting the website for the first time. Our goal was to make something that is informative but also enjoyable to explore.
